notice: Directory of places to research. Prize amounts, eligibility, scope and availability change; verify on the linked official site before acting.

items.name: HackerOne
items.description: Public vulnerability disclosure and bug-bounty programs.

items.name: Bugcrowd
items.description: Crowdsourced security programs with program-specific scopes.

items.name: Immunefi
items.description: Web3 bug-bounty programs; read each program scope before testing.

items.name: Intigriti
items.description: Bug-bounty and vulnerability disclosure programs.

items.name: Code4rena
items.description: Competitive smart-contract audit contests.

items.name: Sherlock Contests
items.description: Smart-contract security contests and audits.

items.name: Sherlock Bug Bounties
items.description: Sherlock-hosted bug-bounty programs; verify LIVE status, exact scope, exclusions, severity rules and submission terms before testing.

items.name: CTFtime
items.description: Calendar and rankings for capture-the-flag competitions.

items.name: CryptoHack
items.description: Cryptography challenges and learning exercises.

items.name: picoCTF
items.description: CTF learning environment and competitions.

items.name: PortSwigger Web Security Academy
items.description: Authorized web-security labs and learning material.

items.name: ETHGlobal
items.description: Ethereum ecosystem hackathons and events.

items.name: Devpost
items.description: Hackathons, challenges and developer competitions.

items.name: DoraHacks
items.description: Hackathons and developer grant opportunities.

items.name: USA.gov Active Federal Challenges
items.description: Official U.S. government discovery page for active prize competitions after Challenge.gov was sunset in March 2026.

items.name: GitHub
items.description: Search public repositories for open-source tools, datasets and challenge resources; respect repository licenses and target authorization.

items.name: Algora
items.description: Open-source and GitHub-linked coding bounties. Before claiming work, verify the issue is still open, reward and acceptance criteria are current, competing claims or landed fixes do not make the task obsolete, and payout terms are clear.

items.name: Topcoder Challenges
items.description: Coding, AI, data, QA and software-development challenges. Verify registration status, reward, deadline, submission and acceptance criteria, required technologies, and whether the challenge is still open before investing work.

items.name: Upwork Software Development Jobs
items.description: Freelance software-development work. Verify the posting is still open, budget and payment terms, client/project legitimacy, technical requirements, deadline, competition, and acceptance/delivery expectations before committing work.

items.name: Freelancer Software Development Jobs
items.description: Programming jobs and project opportunities on Freelancer. Verify the project is still open, budget/payment terms, client legitimacy, required technologies, delivery criteria, deadline, and existing bid competition before committing work.

items.name: Gitcoin Bounty Mechanisms
items.description: Gitcoin's current reference for task-based bounty mechanisms. Treat it as ecosystem discovery rather than a guaranteed live bounty list; follow each lead to its actual funder/platform, then verify open status, deliverables, reward, acceptance criteria, competing claims and payment terms.
